title: Inside That Earthquake of a ‘Summer House’ Reunion and What Comes Next: “Things Have Evolved”

contentText: Bravo executive Josh Brown, who was in the room on reunion taping day, reveals to The Hollywood Reporter how production scrambled to capture the cast reacting to Amanda Batula and West Wilson's relationship, talks dressing rooms and cast tension, answers if we'll ever see that leaked audio moment and shares a cast status update for season 11: "In this friend group, this was about as big of an earthquake as you could imagine."
